slides.heading: How you know it worked
items: The repo's own baseline: the reward hack reproduced from its default config as the reference failure.
Sim metrics over 100 randomized episodes and 3 seeds per arm: joint-tracking RMSE, foot slip and survival, with seed spread reported.
